question: GQ-001
subject: the hook that only protected one clone
the_residual: .git/hooks/ is not version-controlled, so a fresh clone had the protection in name only

fix.what: moved the hook to a tracked .githooks/ directory and set core.hooksPath
fix.verified_end_to_end: created a scratch repo with a real bare remote: an intact chain pushed (exit 0), a chain with "|| true" was REFUSED with chain-swallows-failure and exit 1
fix.this_is_git_invoking_the_tracked_hook: not me calling the script by hand

the_residual_that_remains_and_is_now_DET.what: core.hooksPath is per-clone config, not tracked content — a fresh clone has the hook FILE and no hook
the_residual_that_remains_and_is_now_DET.so: audit-verify-chain.mjs now reports hooks-not-wired when core.hooksPath is not .githooks
the_residual_that_remains_and_is_now_DET.verified: 0 findings in this repo; hooks-not-wired on a fresh clone
the_residual_that_remains_and_is_now_DET.why_this_matters: a residual nobody is told about is the same defect as an unreachable mechanism — the thing I have fixed four times in two days

a_baseline_my_own_change_broke.what: gates-are-load-bearing.sh reported BASELINE FAILED immediately after
a_baseline_my_own_change_broke.cause: the scratch copy has no core.hooksPath, so the new check fired there — correctly
a_baseline_my_own_change_broke.fix: the scratch copy now wires hooks, matching real conditions
a_baseline_my_own_change_broke.note: second time today a guard I added broke a test for a reason unrelated to what the test measures
